given: an existing stock row whose inventory_code is a well-formed hyphen-delimited code carrying a distinct batch segment and a distinct serial segment
when: the up migration runs its backfill
then: that row's batch_number holds the extracted batch segment and its serial_number holds the extracted serial segment, exactly as parsed from the code
architectural_notes: Infra contract on the Alembic migration backfill transform, not a runtime layer (the parsing rule is confined to the migration so no runtime layer inherits legacy-code-format logic). The new batch_number/serial_number columns are NULLABLE per PI2-batch-serial-nullable, which is what lets the backfill write extracted values for conforming codes and NULL for the rest. Verified by an R4/NFR-F6-4 real-branch integration test that seeds a well-formed code, runs the up migration, and asserts the two extracted segments.
